_comment: Controls the weekday leads-digest email. Edit freely, no code changes needed.
_from_email_note: Resend's shared sender works immediately. Switch to your own verified domain later for a less spammy-looking sender.
_only_todays_captures_note: true = digest shows only leads captured this run (recommended, avoids re-showing old Unreviewed leads every day). false = shows every still-Unreviewed lead regardless of when it was captured.
